title: Customising your order
blurb: Kurang manis, kosong, tak nak timun — getting it the way you like it.

notes.title: tak nak …
notes.body: Tak nak + thing is the everyday “I don't want …”: tak nak ais, tak nak timun. Softer than it sounds in English, especially with ye on the end.

notes.title: kurang vs kosong
notes.body: Kurang manis is less sugar; kosong (lit. “empty”) is none at all. On roti, kosong means plain.

notes.title: … boleh?
notes.body: Tack boleh? onto a request to ask “is that okay?”: sambal asing boleh?

p3.note: sangat after a word = very / too.

p5.en: Want to add a fried egg?

p8.en: One iced black coffee, no sugar.
p8.note: o = no milk; kosong = no sugar.

p9.note: langsung after a negative = at all.

p11.en: No need to put it in.

p13.note: teh o = tea, no milk (it still comes sweet unless you say otherwise).

p14.en: I'll put it on the side.

dialogue.ms: Bang, nak minum apa?
dialogue.en: What do you want to drink?

dialogue.ms: Teh o ais satu. Kurang manis.
dialogue.en: One iced tea, no milk. Less sweet.

dialogue.ms: Makan?
dialogue.en: Food?

dialogue.ms: Nasi lemak satu. Tak nak pedas.
dialogue.en: One nasi lemak. I don't want it spicy.

dialogue.ms: Tambah telur?
dialogue.en: Add an egg?

dialogue.ms: Boleh. Terima kasih.
dialogue.en: Sure. Thank you.

gist.q: How does he want his order?
options: Tea less sweet, nasi lemak not spicy
Tea with no ice, nasi lemak extra spicy
gist.why: Kurang manis for the tea, tak nak pedas for the nasi lemak.

listen.ms: Kopi o ais satu. Kurang manis.
listen.en: One iced black coffee. Less sweet.
wrong: One hot black coffee. No sugar.
One iced milk tea. Less sweet.

listen.ms: Teh ais satu. Tak nak manis.
listen.en: One iced milk tea. Not sweet.

listen.ms: Nak pedas ke tak nak pedas?

wrong: Do you want it sweet or not sweet?

listen.ms: Nasi lemak dua. Satu tak nak pedas.
listen.en: Two nasi lemak. One not spicy.

listen.ms: Nasi lemak satu, tambah telur. Teh o ais kurang manis.
listen.en: One nasi lemak, add an egg. Iced tea, less sweet.

read.why: A polite no: tak nak, terima kasih.

read.right: Teh o ais satu, kurang manis.
read.why: She asked about drinks, so order one.

read.en: One nasi lemak, a bit spicy.

dialogue.ms: Bang, nak order apa?
dialogue.en: What would you like to order?

dialogue.ms: Teh o ais limau satu, kurang manis. Ais tak nak banyak sangat.
dialogue.en: One iced lime tea, less sweet. Not too much ice.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Makan?
dialogue.en: Okay. Food?

dialogue.ms: Nasi lemak satu. Sambal asing boleh?
dialogue.en: One nasi lemak. Can the sambal be separate?

dialogue.ms: Boleh. Nak tambah telur mata ke ayam goreng?
dialogue.en: Sure. Want to add a fried egg or fried chicken?

dialogue.ms: Telur mata je. Tak nak timun ye.
dialogue.en: Just the fried egg. No cucumber, okay.

dialogue.ms: Okay, sambal asing, tambah telur mata, tak nak timun. Air tadi kurang manis kan?
dialogue.en: Okay, sambal separate, add a fried egg, no cucumber. The drink was less sweet, right?

dialogue.ms: Ha'ah, kurang manis.
dialogue.en: Yep, less sweet.

gist.q: Which of these did he ask for?
options: Sambal on the side and no cucumber
Fried chicken instead of the egg
A hot tea with no ice at all
gist.why: Sambal asing boleh? … tak nak timun ye.

listen.ms: Teh o limau panas satu. Tak nak manis sangat.
listen.en: One hot lime tea. Not too sweet.
wrong: One iced lime tea. Extra sweet.
One hot lime tea. No sugar at all.

listen.ms: Nasi lemak satu. Timun tak nak, sambal nak banyak.
listen.en: One nasi lemak. No cucumber, lots of sambal.
Do you want the sambal separate or mixed in?

listen.ms: Ayam goreng je. Tak nak telur mata.
listen.en: Just fried chicken. No fried egg.

listen.ms: Okay, nasi lemak, sambal campur, tambah ayam goreng. Air tadi ais tak nak banyak kan?
listen.en: Okay, nasi lemak, sambal mixed in, add fried chicken. And the drink was not too much ice, right?

read.prompt: Nak tambah telur mata ke ayam goreng?
read.right: Dua-dua tak nak. Nasi lemak biasa je.
read.why: Neither: dua-dua tak nak, just the regular one.

read.ms: Sambal tak nak banyak sangat ye.

read.why: She's asking about the cucumber, so answer about the cucumber.

read.ms: Air tadi kurang manis ke biasa?
read.en: Was the drink less sweet or regular?

dialogue.ms: Bang, dah boleh order?
dialogue.en: Ready to order?

dialogue.ms: Dah. Kopi o ais satu, kosong. Betul-betul kosong tau, tak nak gula langsung.
dialogue.en: Yes. One iced black coffee, no sugar. Really none, okay, no sugar at all.

dialogue.ms: Okay, kopi o ais kosong. Tapi kopi kita memang pekat sikit, pahit tau. Okay ke?
dialogue.en: Okay, iced black coffee, no sugar. But our coffee is quite strong, it's bitter, you know. Is that okay?

dialogue.ms: Takpe, saya memang suka pahit.
dialogue.en: That's fine, I actually like it bitter.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Makan apa?
dialogue.en: Okay. What are you eating?

dialogue.ms: Nasi lemak biasa satu. Sambal tu pedas sangat tak?
dialogue.en: One regular nasi lemak. Is that sambal very spicy?

dialogue.ms: Pedas jugak lah. Kalau tak tahan, saya letak asing.
dialogue.en: It's fairly spicy. If you can't take it, I'll put it on the side.

dialogue.ms: Ha, letak asing lah. Lepas tu tak nak timun, ganti dengan telur rebus boleh?
dialogue.en: Yeah, put it on the side. And no cucumber — can you swap it for a boiled egg?

dialogue.ms: Ganti tak boleh lah bang, tapi tambah telur seringgit je.
dialogue.en: Can't swap it, but adding an egg is only one ringgit.

dialogue.ms: Okay lah, tambah je. Timun tu tak payah letak.
dialogue.en: Okay then, just add it. No need to put the cucumber in.

dialogue.ms: Okay, siap. Duduk dulu, nanti saya hantar.
dialogue.en: Okay, done. Have a seat, I'll bring it over.

gist.q: What happened when he asked to swap the cucumber for an egg?
options: No swap, but he could add an egg for one ringgit
She said eggs were sold out
He decided to keep the cucumber
gist.why: Ganti tak boleh … tapi tambah telur seringgit je.

listen.ms: Teh kita memang manis sikit. Kalau nak kosong, kena cakap dulu.
listen.en: Our tea is on the sweet side. If you want no sugar, you have to say so first.
wrong: Our tea has no sugar unless you ask.
Our tea is bitter; you should add sugar.
We can't make tea without sugar.

listen.ms: Sambal tu kalau pedas sangat, saya tak tahan.
listen.en: If that sambal is very spicy, I can't take it.

listen.ms: Ganti boleh, tapi kena tambah seringgit.
listen.en: You can swap it, but it's one ringgit extra.
wrong: You can't swap it, but adding one is free.
You can only swap it if you add an egg.

listen.ms: Takpe, saya memang tak suka manis.
listen.en: It's fine, I really don't like sweet.

listen.ms: Kopi o panas satu, kurang manis. Lepas tu nasi lemak biasa, timun tak payah letak, sambal letak asing.
listen.en: One hot black coffee, less sweet. Then a regular nasi lemak, no need for cucumber, sambal on the side.

read.prompt: Sambal ni pedas tau. Nak letak asing ke?
read.right: Ha, letak asing lah. Saya tak tahan pedas.
read.why: She's offering to put it on the side; accept and say why.

read.ms: Telur rebus tu tak payah tambah.
read.en: No need to add that boiled egg.

read.why: Confirm it: betul, no sugar at all.
